new_tests.purpose: Validate deterministic fake multi-stage soak timelines, ordered JSONL samples, per-window summaries, missing semantics, and bounded fake/non-real evidence classification.

Validate the L09 artifact audit rejects missing windows, empty or unordered JSONL, invented metrics, invalid percentile ordering, unreasoned missing data, long-run claims from bounded profiles, cleanup gaps, and P14 real coverage.
CI guard for the L09 audit command, schema validation, required profile node counts, bounded/resource-aware 30/50/100 semantics, and P14 boundary.
Verify stability trend/window metrics and 30/50/100 profile states are sourced from stability_soak_metrics.json and JSONL artifacts.
Verify provenance edges from stability JSONL, baseline comparison, resource preflights, real evidence, cleanup reports, and profile artifacts into the L09 rollup.
Verify rendered loop reports include stability trends, window comparisons, missing metrics, bounded profile labels, and no report-view source backflow.

new_artifact_checks: All L09 stability profiles include bounded=true for short automatic windows and long_run_stability_claim=false.
The five windows baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post_recovery exist in report summaries and JSONL time series.
Latency p50/p95/p99 are present per measured window with p50 <= p95 <= p99, or explicitly MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reasons.
Memory growth/leak summaries and restart deltas are measured from source samples or explicitly MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reasons.
Error taxonomy is window-aware and uses stable categories rather than raw strings alone.
Baseline comparison preserves NO_BASELINE_YET or measured deltas with reasons.
Small-real evidence requires producer scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x, nodes_observed >= 6, data_path_result PASS, schema validation PASS, and cleanup PASS.
30/50/100 profiles require resource preflight and either bounded measured JSONL with cleanup PASS or resource-aware SKIPPED_WITH_REASON; fake-only evidence cannot satisfy real coverage.
P14/1000 real stability evidence is forbidden and real_valkey_coverage must remain false for 1000-dry-run entries.
Rendered Markdown, HTML, SVG, and CSV outputs are views only and cannot be metric sources.

expected_initial_failures.name: missing_l09_stability_audit
expected_initial_failures.reason: scripts/audit_stability_soak_metrics.py and artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/stability_soak_metrics.json do not exist yet.

expected_initial_failures.name: missing_multistage_windows
expected_initial_failures.reason: P11 stability_report.json and stability_metrics.jsonl do not encode baseline, steady, fault, recovery, and post_recovery windows.

expected_initial_failures.name: permissive_stability_schema
expected_initial_failures.reason: schemas/artifact/stability_report.schema.json does not require L09 window summaries, JSONL paths, bounded profile semantics, or missing reasons.

expected_initial_failures.name: missing_30_50_100_stability_profiles
expected_initial_failures.reason: P12/P13 have scale and fault/failover artifacts but no L09 stability soak profile artifacts for 30, 50, and 100 nodes.

expected_initial_failures.name: coverage_and_report_gap
expected_initial_failures.reason: Metric catalog, coverage matrix, provenance graph, and rendered loop reports do not expose L09 stability trend/window coverage.

acceptance_criteria: The L09 harness catches missing windows, fake-as-real evidence, P14 real evidence, invented metrics, long-run claims from bounded windows, and report-view source backflow.
Every soak profile emits JSONL time series and schema-valid profile/rollup artifacts.
Small-real P11 stability evidence is wrapper-produced and includes real Valkey 9.1.x, data-path proof, live node probes, schema validation, and cleanup PASS.
30/50/100 profiles are bounded measured profiles with resource preflight and cleanup proof, or explicit resource-aware SKIPPED_WITH_REASON profiles that do not count as real coverage.
Reports display stability trends, window comparisons, missing metrics, and bounded labels from machine-readable artifacts only.
P14 remains dry-run/opt-in only and is not executed for L09.
Review, validation, and anti-regression agents approve before commit.
